claims.claim: Rockwell sits on the industrial-automation/OT control path linking manufacturing labor scarcity, productivity and reshoring to programmable control, software and connected production infrastructure.

The same installed OT footprint that creates switching friction and recurring integration value also creates a successor bottleneck in cybersecurity: Rockwell's 2026 filing describes active exploitation of internet-facing OT devices across critical infrastructure and dependence on customer configuration/security practices outside its control.

Structural resilience therefore depends not only on automation demand but on maintaining trusted secure control infrastructure against open/competing automation stacks and cyber-driven replacement pressure.

falsifiers: Industrial automation spending growth accompanied by sustained Rockwell share loss would weaken bottleneck control.
Open/alternative control architectures materially reducing switching costs would weaken substitution resilience.
Material security failures attributable to Rockwell products could invert installed-base advantage into liability.

risks.risk: Cybersecurity is a first-order causal dependency for industrial control infrastructure.
Customer implementation and network hygiene can create failures outside Rockwell's direct control but still affect product trust.

unknowns.unknown: This Beta object does not quantify customer concentration; that remains an Alpha underwriting gate in the inherited queue.

claims.claim: Cyber exposure is a documented present risk rather than hypothetical bearishness: Rockwell disclosed elevated OT threats and April 2026 U.S. government warnings of active exploitation of internet-facing industrial control devices.
Debt requires monitoring but the cited Q3 filing does not by itself establish distress: short-term commercial paper was $684M at June 30, 2026 versus $522M at September 30, 2025.
The inherited exact underwriting gate remains customer concentration; Beta does not convert that missing Alpha evidence into a false blocker for its own perspectives.

risks.risk: OT cyber incidents can create reputational, liability and customer-continuity damage.
Commercial-paper balance increased versus fiscal year-end, warranting continued liquidity/debt monitoring.

unknowns.unknown: Latest customer concentration is not established in this Beta object.
No present accounting-quality or governance-abuse defect is evidenced here.
